accept.title: One thing before you start
accept.subtitle: Your account was created through your identity provider, so you haven't seen these yet. Have a read, then agree to carry on.

cookies.label: Cookie choices
cookies.title: Your cookie choices
cookies.body: {{appName}} needs a few things in this browser to work at all — what keeps you signed in, the theme you picked, what you had open. Beyond that, it's up to you.
cookies.spamCheck: If you make an account, the sign-up form loads a spam check from {{provider}}, which sets a cookie of its own.

necessary.name: Essential
necessary.description: Signing in, your preferences, and what you had open. There is no version of Initiative without these.
